## Libraries
```{r import libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(sjPlot)
library(performance)

```

## Data Wranging
```{r Data Wrangling}
# Import Weekly data - Last updated April 8th, 2026
weekly <- read_xlsx("Brewers Plots/DataFiles/Capstone Data_4_20.xlsx", sheet = "Weekly Brewers Bay monitoring")
weekly$Date <- as.Date(weekly$Date)

before_after <- weekly%>% 
  filter(Date %in% c("2026-02-28", "2026-04-18"))

onetime <- read_xlsx("Brewers Plots/DataFiles/Capstone Data_4_20.xlsx", sheet = "One Time Measurements") %>% 
  select(-Date)

brewers_weekly<- weekly %>%
  left_join(onetime, by = "Plot ID") %>% 
  select("Date", "Plot ID":"Grwth/O", "Hedging Type", "N Length (cm)":"W Width (cm)") 

brewers <- before_after %>%
  left_join(onetime, by = "Plot ID") %>% 
  select("Date", "Plot ID":"Grwth/O", "Hedging Type", "N Length (cm)":"W Width (cm)") 

brewers$totalvolumne_m3 <- 
  ((brewers$`N Length (cm)` *  brewers$`N Height (cm)` *  brewers$`N Width (cm)`) + (brewers$`E Length (cm)` *  brewers$`E Height (cm)` *  brewers$`E Width (cm)`) + (brewers$`S Length (cm)` *  brewers$`S Height (cm)` *  brewers$`S Width (cm)`) + (brewers$`W Length (cm)` *  brewers$`W Height (cm)` *  brewers$`W Width (cm)`)) / 1000000

```

## Data Visualization
```{r}
## Weekly plot
ggplot(brewers_weekly) +
  geom_jitter(aes(x = Date, y = `Meets Hedge`, color = as.factor(`Hedging Type`)),
              alpha = 0.4, width = 0, height = 0.01) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,1)) +
  theme_bw()

## meets before/after plot
ggplot(brewers) +
  geom_jitter(aes(x = Date, y = `Meets Hedge`, color = as.factor(`Hedging Type`)),
              alpha = 0.4, width = 0, height = 0.01) +
  theme_bw()

ggplot(filter(brewers, Date == "2026-04-18")) +
  geom_jitter(aes(x = `totalvolumne_m3`, y = `Meets Hedge`, color = as.factor(`Hedging Type`)),
              alpha = 0.4, width = 0, height = 0.01) +
  theme_bw()

ggplot(filter(brewers, Date == "2026-04-18")) +
  geom_jitter(aes(x = `totalvolumne_m3`, y = `Grwth/O`, color = as.factor(`Hedging Type`)),
              alpha = 0.4, width = 0, height = 0.01) +
  theme_bw()

ggplot(filter(brewers, Date == "2026-04-18")) +
  geom_jitter(aes(x = `totalvolumne_m3`, y = `Grwth/U`, color = as.factor(`Hedging Type`)),
              alpha = 0.4, width = 0, height = 0.01) +
  theme_bw()

## Grwth/O before/after plot
ggplot(brewers) +
  geom_jitter(aes(x = Date, y = `Grwth/O`, color = as.factor(`Hedging Type`)),
              alpha = 0.4, width = 0, height = 0.01) +
  theme_bw()

## Grwth/U before/after plot
ggplot(brewers) +
  geom_jitter(aes(x = Date, y = `Grwth/U`, color = as.factor(`Hedging Type`)),
              alpha = 0.4, width = 0, height = 0.01) +
  theme_bw()

```

## Binomial Logistic Regression
```{r}

## Meets the Hedge
meetsmodel <- glm(`Meets Hedge` ~ `Hedging Type` + totalvolumne_m3, family = "binomial", data = brewers)
summary(meetsmodel)

check_model(meetsmodel)
check_overdispersion(meetsmodel)

meetsmodel <- glm(`Meets Hedge` ~ `Hedging Type`, family = "binomial", data = brewers)
summary(meetsmodel)

check_model(meetsmodel)
check_overdispersion(meetsmodel)

## Growth Under
growthUmodel <- glm(`Grwth/U` ~ `Hedging Type` + totalvolumne_m3, family = "binomial", data = brewers)
summary(growthUmodel)

check_model(growthUmodel)
check_overdispersion(growthUmodel)

growthUmodel <- glm(`Grwth/U` ~ `Hedging Type`, family = "binomial", data = brewers)
summary(growthUmodel)

check_model(growthUmodel)
check_overdispersion(growthUmodel)

## Growth Over
growthOmodel <- glm(`Grwth/O` ~ `Hedging Type` + totalvolumne_m3, family = "binomial", data = brewers)
summary(growthOmodel)

check_model(growthOmodel)
check_overdispersion(growthOmodel)

growthOmodel <- glm(`Grwth/O` ~ `Hedging Type`, family = "binomial", data = brewers)
summary(growthOmodel)

check_model(growthOmodel)
check_overdispersion(growthOmodel)

ggplot(brewers_weekly, aes(Date, ))+
  geom_bar(fill = `Hedging Type`)

```
No significant results 
using a propotional stacked bar plot (the proportion that met the hedge)
p(Hedge) y time on x color by hedge 

## Including time
```{r}
# predicting the day at which the seagrass meets the head (like octopus example)

brewers_weekly$day <- brewers_weekly$Date - brewers_weekly$Date[1]

Day since starting is now the response variable

meetsmodeltime <- glm(`Meets Hedge` ~ `Hedging Type` + day, family = "binomial", data = brewers_weekly)
summary(meetsmodeltime)

check_model(meetsmodeltime)
check_overdispersion(meetsmodel)

ggpredict to plot the fitted line on the time 

as.numeric the day column

gOmodeltime <- glm(`Grwth/O` ~ `Hedging Type` + as.numeric(day), family = "binomial", data = brewers_weekly)
summary(gOmodeltime)

check_model(gOmodeltime)
check_overdispersion(gOmodeltime)
```
 the seagrass changing through time 
 even in this short time we are seeing a significant effect of day
